categories.rationale: Deprecating `encryptwallet` addresses a major fund-safety footgun where encrypting existing wallets invalidates prior backups and alters spending conditions unexpectedly. As noted in RFC #36027 and issue #26607, encrypting an active wallet leaves unencrypted material on disk and changes spending conditions out from under the user, making deprecation strategically important for fund safety.
